description: This script manages review lifecycle dates for components in a repository, specifically starting, stopping, and clearing cycle dates stored in metadata.yaml files. It provides commands to initiate review periods with deadlines and target green dates, as well as to clear these dates across all components. The script also includes helper functions and usage instructions.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds all components in the repository by searching for metadata.yaml files and excludes docs and scripts directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and returns the path to a component's metadata.yaml file, providing an error if not found.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Adds a specified number of business days to a given date, skipping weekends.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears lifecycle date fields in a metadata.yaml file by replacing date values with '~'.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Calls an external script to regenerate the RAG report.
